question: On an original constant-feature fixture with unequal group sizes, does the existing mean-only dummy omit an elementary constant aligned with equal-group MAE?
fixture: 12 groups in index order; groups 0,1,2 each have 40 rows with target 10; groups 3..11 each have 4 rows with target 0; only predictor constant_feature=1; arbitrary response units
constant_rule: Use outer training targets only. Group-mean and lower group-weighted median give each training group equal total weight, then equal weight to its rows. Lower weighted median is first observed target reaching half total weight; ties are not chosen using held-out targets.
fit_schedule: One actual benchmark call: 3 outer folds * (6 candidates * 2 inner folds + 3 family refits) = 45 pipeline fits; 9 analytic constants; no additional refit, seed search or result-driven retry
criterion: Software diagnostic only: retain all methods and both weighting conventions; check exact outer membership parity, analytic constants, complete finite predictions, and actual fit count. No superiority/significance/generalization gate.
interpretation: Deliberately constructed teaching fixture, not independent scientific N, natural data, a new empirical discovery, or evidence of real-data model superiority. Does not change product defaults.
